name: Pawniard
description: The Sharp Blade Pokémon. They fight at Bisharp's command. They cling to their prey and inflict damage by sinking their blades into it.

abilities.description: While this Pokémon is suffering from a negative status effect or stat change imposed by an opponent, it gains +2 to all attack rolls.
